thread:
Maria Lopez: Just closed CivicCare (signed MSA + 12mo commit). High level: core use is document summarization + private QA over PHI (SOC2 + HIPAA conversation on the contract). They requested a private deployment in us-east with VPC peering, dedicated capacity (4x A100 equiv) and 30k qps burst estimate over first 90 days. Need a tightly coordinated handoff — sending flight plan below.

Casey Nguyen: Ok — I'll own onboarding. Thanks Maria. Can we do a quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? I'll pull in support & solutions. Who is the billing contact?

Maria Lopez: Billing is Aaron Kim at CivicCare (aaron.kim@civiccare.com). Exec sponsor is CTO Priya Desai. SOW link: https://redwood.internal/sows/CIVIC-2026-01 (internal). Key risk: legal flagged data-residency clause; engineering needs to confirm private control-plane options.

Sophie Patel: Quick ask — what are CivicCare success metrics? Is it latency < 250ms P95, cost per 1k tokens <$0.10, or something else? Also want to know the three prioritized flows so we can prep enablement docs.

Maria Lopez: Priya's ask: 1) sub-second interactive latency for short queries, 2) 99.9% uptime SLA, 3) deterministic redaction for PHI before storage. Top flows: a) patient-summary generation, b) claims extraction pipeline, c) clinician chat.

Oliver Chen: Noted. From infra side I need: VPC CIDR, whether they require egress restrictions, expected avg seq length, and token distribution. Also confirm model family (they asked for a Llama2-like variant but HIPAA requires private). If we're doing Dedicated -> map to Dedicated pool with private control-plane.

Casey Nguyen: Owners & next steps (quick list):
- Casey Nguyen: onboarding lead, kickoff + runbook owner
- Oliver Chen: infra + peering + Dedicated sizing
- Sophie Patel: enablement, playbooks, training sessions
- Maria Lopez: exec liaison + contract clarifications
- Aaron Kim (CivicCare): billing / provisioning approvals

Maria Lopez: I'll drop the customer-provided networking details in this thread after their IT sends them (~today EOD). Also legal asked for an architecture diagram showing private control-plane — Oliver can you draft a minimal diagram we can attach?

Oliver Chen: Yep, I'll sketch a diagram and attach it to the ticket. For sizing, 4x A100 equiv sounds fine as a starting point but recommend we set autoscale to 6x for peak + fallback to hosted smaller model. Also, we should enable prefix KV caching for summaries to reduce cost.

Sophie Patel: For enablement: planning two 1-hr sessions the week after kickoff — one infra + SSO, one product training (prompts, evals). I also want to surface our recommended eval suite for PHI safety and regression alerts.

Maria Lopez: Action: Legal to confirm data-residency clause by Tue EOD; Engineering to provide architecture PNG + network checklist by Wed noon; Onboarding kickoff scheduled Thu 10:00am PT once we have peering details.

deploy-bot: deployment-ticket REDWOOD-4231 created for CivicCare private onboarding (assign: oliver_chen). ETA draft: 3 business days for infra prep.

Casey Nguyen: I'll create a shared onboarding board and invite CivicCare. Can we use the standard private-deploy checklist but add HIPAA eval gate and SOC2 attestations? Sophie, can you draft that gate?

Sophie Patel: Yup — I'll add an Eval gate with: PHI redaction smoke tests, regression corpus (10 critical prompts), and manual review for first 50 generated summaries. Also will capture feedback via the shared doc.

Maria Lopez: One more risk: renewal watch — this is an important early enterprise win; set a renewal flag for 9 months out and track usage vs commit monthly. If we see heavy overage, we should surface to sales for expansion opps.

Oliver Chen: FYI — network config snippet CivicCare prefers (from their IT):
```
VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16
Peering: allow ports 443, 10250
No outbound internet except to redwood-control.redwood.net
```

Casey Nguyen: Great. I'll confirm kickoff time in calendar, share the board, and assign initial tickets. Thanks everyone — lets keep replies short in this thread so we have a clean handoff doc. :rocket:

Maria Lopez: Thanks all — will follow up once legal confirms data-residency wording.

Sophie Patel: Saved. I'll start the training deck template and post link here when ready.

Oliver Chen: Draft diagram + infra ticket updates posted to REDWOOD-4231 by EOD.

Maria Lopez: (adds) Owner summary in case card: Casey (Onboarding), Oliver (Infra), Sophie (Enablement), Maria (Customer Exec), Aaron (Billing).
